_note: A Baidu aerial of Terminal 2 with its wave-form roof is published; the second download was a stock in-flight LOT 787 shot with no airport visible. The Esri World Imagery view is retained.

bud-baidu-1.webp.zh: 从高处俯瞰布达佩斯机场 2 号航站楼：波浪形银色屋顶横跨航站楼，机坪上停着客机，前方是停满车辆的停车场。
bud-baidu-1.webp.en: An elevated view of Budapest's Terminal 2 — the wave-form silver roof across the building, airliners on the apron and a packed car park in front.

bud-sat-1.webp.zh: 从卫星图看，布达佩斯李斯特·费伦茨国际机场（BUD）的机场布局与周边环境清晰可辨。
bud-sat-1.webp.en: In the satellite image, the layout of Budapest Liszt Ferenc International Airport (BUD) and its surroundings are clearly visible.
